title: Jubilant Dutch Flour Pancakes
description: Buttery, fluffy pancakes with a Sichuan pepper kick, cooked in a stone bowl dolsot for a show‑off Dutch breakfast that keeps Ayurvedic tamasic principles in mind.
instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and Sichuan pepper in a medium bowl until combined.
Whisk milk, egg, sugar, vanilla, and melted butter in a separate bowl until smooth.
Pour wet ingredients into dry, stirring gently until just blended; lumps are fine.
Heat the stone bowl dolsot over medium, add butter to coat the surface.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the hot bowl, tilting to spread, and cook until bubbles form, 2-3 minutes.
Flip the pancake with a spatula and brown the other side, 1-2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining batter, greasing the bowl between batches as needed.
Transfer pancakes to a plate, drizzle with extra melted butter.
Serve hot, dusted with optional Sichuan pepper or powdered sugar if desired.
